sssw_definition.phase_order: QS -> GI -> SSSW -> SLT -> SSLW -> GT
sssw_definition.start: the first recurring load-peak candidate used as the operational GI-end boundary
sssw_definition.end: the selected load-peak boundary immediately before the single SLT region; boundaries are fitted from the full trial using two-regime cycle features
sssw_definition.status: model-assisted provisional; load peaks are not verified heel-strike annotations

cycle_grouping.candidate_landmark_definition: successive recurring load-peak candidates inside the SSSW boundary, not validated gait-cycle labels
cycle_grouping.reason: The dataset stores one continuous SSSW region per limb-specific trace. Candidate interpeak intervals vary by trial and limb, and they are not assigned five repetition identifiers.
